scripts.script:
-- auto-gym script for shigaku, basically just presses q/e when it has to
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local VIM = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local enabled = true
local RETRY_DELAY = 0.35 -- re-press if a box stays red this long
local keys = { Q = Enum.KeyCode.Q, E = Enum.KeyCode.E }
local wasRed = { Q = false, E = false }
local lastPress = { Q = 0, E = 0 }
local boxes = { Q = nil, E = nil }

local function isRed(c)
    return c.R > 0.6 and c.G < 0.4 and c.B < 0.4
end

local function isLetter(d, letter)
    if not d:IsA("GuiObject") then return false end
    if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton")) then
        local t = d.Text:gsub("%s", ""):upper()
        if t == letter then return true end
    end
    return d.Name:upper() == letter
end

local function visibleChain(d)
    local o = d
    while o and o ~= playerGui do
        if o:IsA("GuiObject") and not o.Visible then return false end
        if o:IsA("ScreenGui") and not o.Enabled then return false end
        o = o.Parent
    end
    return o == playerGui
end

-- find a visible Q, then a visible E inside the same container
local function locate()
    for _, q in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if isLetter(q, "Q") and visibleChain(q) then
            local anc = q.Parent
            for _ = 1, 6 do
                if not anc or anc == playerGui then break end
                for _, d in ipairs(anc:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d ~= q and isLetter(d, "E") and visibleChain(d) then
                        boxes.Q, boxes.E = q, d
                        return
                    end
                end
                anc = anc.Parent
            end
        end
    end
    boxes.Q, boxes.E = nil, nil
end

local function colorRed(o)
    if o:IsA("GuiObject") and o.BackgroundTransparency < 1 and isRed(o.BackgroundColor3) then
        return true
    end
    if (o:IsA("ImageLabel") or o:IsA("ImageButton")) and isRed(o.ImageColor3) then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function boxIsRed(obj)
    if not obj or not obj.Parent then return false end
    if colorRed(obj) then return true end
    local p = obj.Parent
    for _ = 1, 2 do
        if p and p ~= playerGui and colorRed(p) then return true end
        p = p and p.Parent
    end
    for _, c in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
        if colorRed(c) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function press(letter, obj)
    lastPress[letter] = tick()
    if obj and obj:IsA("GuiButton") and getconnections then
        for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(obj.MouseButton1Click)) do pcall(c.Fire, c) end
        for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(obj.Activated)) do pcall(c.Fire, c) end
    end
    VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, keys[letter], false, game)
    task.wait(0.05)
    VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, keys[letter], false, game)
end

-- toggle button + status
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "AutoQE"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 44)
btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, 0)
btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 70)
btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
btn.TextSize = 12
btn.Text = "Auto QE: ON"
btn.Active = true
btn.Draggable = true
btn.Parent = gui
Instance.new("UICorner", btn)

btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    enabled = not enabled
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 70) or Color3.fromRGB(170, 50, 50)
end)

local lastScan = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not enabled then btn.Text = "Auto QE: OFF" return end

    -- rescan if boxes are missing OR no longer visible (hidden UI counts as gone)
    local stale = not boxes.Q or not boxes.E
        or not boxes.Q.Parent or not boxes.E.Parent
        or not visibleChain(boxes.Q) or not visibleChain(boxes.E)
    if stale and tick() - lastScan > 0.25 then
        lastScan = tick()
        locate()
        wasRed.Q, wasRed.E = false, false
    end

    local status = {}
    for letter in pairs(keys) do
        local obj = boxes[letter]
        local red = boxIsRed(obj)
        status[letter] = obj and (red and "red" or "--") or "none"
        if red and (not wasRed[letter] or tick() - lastPress[letter] > RETRY_DELAY) then
            task.spawn(press, letter, obj)
        end
        wasRed[letter] = red
    end
    btn.Text = ("Auto QE: ON\nQ:%s  E:%s"):format(status.Q, status.E)
end)

--// MINI PLATFORM RGB SPAWNER
--// ================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

--// ================================
--// BEÁLLÍTÁSOK
--// ================================

local SETTINGS = {

	-- Platform mérete
	PlatformSize = Vector3.new(5, 0.7, 5),

	-- Milyen messze legyen előtted
	PlatformDistance = 4,

	-- Lekerekítés
	CornerSize = 0.35,

	-- RGB sebesség
	RGBSpeed = 0.35,

	-- Gomb mérete
	ButtonWidth = 85,
	ButtonHeight = 38,

	-- Jobb felső sarok
	RightOffset = 15,
	TopOffset = 15,

	-- Felirat
	TextSize = 16,
}

--// ================================
--// GUI
--// ================================

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PlatformSpawner"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(
	0,
	SETTINGS.ButtonWidth,
	0,
	SETTINGS.ButtonHeight
)

frame.Position = UDim2.new(
	1,
	-SETTINGS.ButtonWidth - SETTINGS.RightOffset,
	0,
	SETTINGS.TopOffset
)

frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Parent = gui

local frameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
frameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
frameCorner.Parent = frame

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Thickness = 3
stroke.Parent = frame

--// ================================
--// SPAWN GOMB
--// ================================

local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -6)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3)

button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
button.BorderSizePixel = 0

button.Text = "SPAWN"
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
button.TextSize = SETTINGS.TextSize
button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

button.Parent = frame

local buttonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
buttonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
buttonCorner.Parent = button

--// ================================
--// RGB FÜGGVÉNY
--// ================================

local function startRGB(object)

	task.spawn(function()

		local hue = 0

		while object.Parent do

			hue += 0.01

			if hue >= 1 then
				hue = 0
			end

			object.Color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)

			task.wait(SETTINGS.RGBSpeed / 10)

		end

	end)

end

-- RGB a gomb körül
startRGB(stroke)

--// ================================
--// PLATFORM LÉTREHOZÁSA
--// ================================

button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end

	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end

	-- A karakter HASA ELŐTT
	local position =
		root.Position
		+ root.CFrame.LookVector * SETTINGS.PlatformDistance

	-- Fő platform
	local platform = Instance.new("Part")

	platform.Name = "MiniRGBPlatform"

	platform.Size = SETTINGS.PlatformSize
	platform.Position = position

	platform.Anchored = true
	platform.CanCollide = true

	platform.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	platform.Parent = workspace

	-- Valódi lekerekítés
	local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh

	-- A platform alapformája maradjon lapos
	mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)

	-- RGB
	startRGB(platform)

end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local running = true

local connection
connection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete then
		running = false
		if connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	local winPart = workspace:WaitForChild("WinPart")
	
	while running do
		local character = localPlayer.Character
		local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		
		if hrp and winPart then
			hrp.CFrame = winPart.CFrame
			
			local prompt = winPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
			if prompt then
				fireproximityprompt(prompt)
			end
		end
		
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end)
